status_authority: Local execution report; this specification does not record project completion.
scale_interpretation: Current and historical partitions use the existing AWR normalized statuses. Each source work key counts once; repeated Git versions or repeated evidence references do not create additional work items. Unknown statuses remain visible and are not guessed into either partition. The design's several-hundred-KB description is operationalized as at least 200 KiB of the actual ledger, without generated padding.
provenance: Use an existing real project supplied for the benchmark. Bind the original source bytes, Git state when available, mapping and frozen copy. Labels, a generated large file or a boolean declaration are not proof of real project provenance.
domain_richness: Verify multiple actual milestones and decisions, substantial evidence, and test/history records. Record their observed counts, distinct references and source locations; inspect their business relevance. Do not manufacture entries or inflate volume with duplicate references or padding.

runtime_requirements.frozen_source_intake: Index the frozen project's explicit source mapping without changing original files; bind source, project and work identities.
runtime_requirements.bounded_work_read: Read one selected current work with its real acceptance, blocker, next action and dependency facts; the response must not expand the full ledger.
runtime_requirements.idempotent_and_incremental_index: An unchanged reindex must preserve IDs and revisions. A controlled source change on a disposable copy must update the intended projection, retain unrelated facts and bind before/after fingerprints.
runtime_requirements.unrelated_history_isolation: Default selected-work context excludes unrelated closed work and its history; explicit historical drill-down remains possible. Necessary dependency facts are assessed separately.
runtime_requirements.projection_rebuild: Rebuild domain projections from the same frozen sources in an independent disposable project and compare source-derived facts. Do not invent runtime sessions, claims, checkpoints or execution history.
runtime_requirements.original_source_unchanged: Recheck original source hashes after preparation and after the run. All mutations belong to explicitly identified disposable copies.
runtime_requirements.public_evidence_redaction: Publish scope, counts, versions, commands and hash bindings. Keep original private text, identities and local paths in retained local evidence; inspect public artifacts before commit.

counting: Structural admission only determines whether a sample may proceed to runtime verification. It does not complete this benchmark, any of the ten metrics, E4, or a release. All required gates need actual evidence before the source ledger can mark this item complete.
